name: Hime Koi ☆ Fechi Koi ~Ano Ko no Seiheki ni Ijou Ari!~
original_name: ひめ恋☆ふぇち恋 ～あの娘の性癖に異常アリ!～
source:
Private Yutoku Gakuen is a co-educational school, but it is a special school where the living spaces for boys and girls are divided.
Because of this, there are constant requests from Rikuto, the photography club, to take pictures of girls.

I'm not enthusiastic, but I'm still taking pictures of girls today...
At that time, some girls suggested that the photography club be abolished.
The landman, who wanted to look back somehow, thought that Eloy photography was more in demand and could show his strength.

So he approaches the girl he's shooting... and negotiates directly to let him take a picture.
While negotiating, he spots a beautiful subject...
